If you’d rather not post publicly, you can send your feedback privately to our team instead. The forum opens in a new tab with a draft of your post. Posting it needs a forum account.

The last two sentences say what happens when the user posts on the forum: a new browser tab opens on the forum with their post already filled in, and they need an account on the forum to publish it.
